text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Please!
Let me... train with you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it wasn't for a race or an interview,
Sakura Chiyono O was somehow wearing her racing outfit
when she approached me with a mysterious request..."
choice_data_list: Why do you want to train?
Why do you want to train?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I want to become a traditional Japanese lady!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "You know how we had this racing outfit designed with a traditional Japanese vibe to match the cherry blossoms?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'm not graceful at all,
nor do I really give off a samurai vibe...”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I love Japanese sweets and sumo, but just liking them
isn't enough to make them worthy of a racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So, I want everyone from the Japanese Style Girls Club
(Chiyo research) to give me some sparring practice!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, I just made that name up yesterday! I was thinking of asking either Grass-san or Yaeno-san for help this time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I feel like the two of you can train me
into the perfect traditional Japanese maiden!
choice_data_list: You don't have to go that far...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, that's exactly how far I want to go!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Whenever I put on this racing attire, it brings back the feelings I had when I first enrolled."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to bloom in full glory here too!"
...Stepping into the Academy with my chest puffed out,
filled with that sparkling feeling...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This Racewear is filled with all my feelings...
I really want to wear it with pride!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I thought if I could have confidence in being a traditional Japanese girl,
maybe I could look pretty too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt it was a wild idea for her, but seeing
that she had a solid reason, I decided to make time
for her training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So I wanted to ask for advice...
Between Grass-san and Yaeno-san,
who should I ask?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The way Grass-san speaks and carries herself is so graceful and precise, isn't it~!
I wish I could be like that too...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: E-Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Grass-san, thank you for having me today!
So, about the training details—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ――The "Monster" Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Both you and I... are chasing that very same great back..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"—Let us see if your blade is truly sharp.
I shall test your strength!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyawawawawawaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Just kidding~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Chiyono O-senpai seemed a bit nervous...
so I just playfully teased her a little bit~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...A-Aha~! Oh,
so it was just a joke~!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you startled me a bit.
There's no way Grass-san could ever be
that scary, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~. I heard you like traditional sweets,
so why don't we have a chat over some matcha~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "I, too, am still striving to become an ideal Yamato Nadeshiko. Let's by all means discuss how to reach that ideal~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's training wasn't just sipping tea
and nibbling sweets... it was the art of tea ceremony.
A rich, relaxing time drifted by...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer~.
Good morning~.
choice_data_list: ...Has the way you talk changed a bit?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Fufu, really~? Maybe I've become more like a graceful Japanese lady~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, would you like to tour some temples and shrines sometime?
Grass-san was telling me all about them the other day~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the impressionable Sakura Chiyono O was influenced by Grass Wonder's gentle way of speaking.
For a while, she couldn't shake off that calm, ladylike demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san...!
I'm sure the training will be tough.
I'll be ready for it!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“—I am still far too inexperienced myself.
I am in no position to teach anyone anything.”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"However... your desire to 'become stronger'
is something I can relate to.
I shall instruct you to the extent of my ability."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Stro... yes, exactly like that!
Thank you for today, I'm looking forward to working with you!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now, before we begin our proper practice...
To show our gratitude for the place we will be using,
let us wipe the floor with rags—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: 100 laps back and forth. Please, do it with me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*...
All done!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Phew... Good work. Now then, onto the real training...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Before that, 100 straight punches.
Let's do them to warm up your body.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...!?
Y-Yikes, yes sir!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Kyu-kyuu... hyafu...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Afaaaaah~~...
Hyafu... That's 100 reps, all done~...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Well done.
Now then, let us begin the real training...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will not.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!?
Is it over already?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ha, could it be that...
I'm a hopeless case...!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, quite the opposite. Precisely because you show such promise,
training is unnecessary for you, Chiyono O-san.
You are already a strong warrior.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Am I... strong?
Even though I'm out of breath right now?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The strength I see in you is mental.
The strength of heart to keep pushing forward
to become the person you want to be...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Once you realize that,
you should be able to carry yourself with confidence,
without needing someone like me to teach you."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yaeno-san...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Martial arts carry a fair share of danger.
So, if you truly wish to learn...
please come talk to me again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes, we shall welcome you with full courtesy.
—Thank you very much for today."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Sakura Chiyono O bowed crisply,
her profile showed a touch more confidence than before.
